ConnectionIPAddress.description: IP Address of Service Entry point to be used

ConnectionPort.description: IP Address of Service Entry point to be used

SSHTunnel.description: Indicates if the user wants to communicate through SSH tunnel

SSHTunnelPortList.description: List of ports to connect to via SSH tunnelling

SSHTunnelProtocol.description: User can now give https or http

SSHTunnelRemotePort.description: Remote Redfish connection port to be used while SSH tunnelling

SSHTunnelRemoteIPAddress.description: IP Address of Remote Port of the SSH tunnel to be used

SSHTunnelUsingSSHPASS.description: Option to use sshpass for portforwarding instead of sshtunnel

AuthenticationRequired.description: Indicates if REST API authentication is required by the Redfish service

PowerOffCommand.description: Command to use to turn off the system

PowerOnCommand.description: Command to use to turn on the system

PowerOffWaitTime.description: Off delay needed (in seconds) during FW Activation

PowerOnWaitTime.description: Wait time (in seconds) during FW Activation post reset cycle

FwStagingTimeMax.description: Maximum time in seconds taken by staging (copy) phase of full device FW update

FwActivationTimeMax.description: Maximum time in seconds taken by activation phase of full device FW update

IdleWaitTimeAfterFirmwareUpdate.description: Wait time (in seconds) for runtime execution delay

SanitizeLog.description: Sanitize log file by removing any sensitive details (i.e. IP and credentials)

SingleShotPowerCycle.description: Option to use Single Shot Power cycle

SingleShotPowerCycleCommand.description: Single command to power off and power on the remote system

SingleShotPowerCycleTimeOut.description: TimeOut duration in seconds for single command power cycle operation

HostIPAddress.description: IP address or hostname of the host OS of the system under test, for tests that act on the host. The built-in SSH client uses the .netrc credentials for this address

HostPort.description: SSH port of the host OS

HostSSHKeyFile.description: Optional private key file for the built-in SSH client

HostCommandPrefix.description: Optional local command that runs a host command given as its last argument, used instead of the built-in SSH client (e.g. ssh -o BatchMode=yes root@myhost)

HostBootWaitTime.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for the host OS to come back after a reboot
